triples.tail_surface: Copper or copper alloys containing more than 65% copper are not to be used in acetylene piping (high or low pressure)
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 禁止使用含铜量超过65%的铜或铜合金
triples.evidence_text: Copper or copper alloys containing more than 65% copper are not to be used in acetylene piping (high or low pressure).

triples.head_surface: internal surface of a hose used to connect an acetylene tank
triples.head_canonical_zh: 连接乙炔瓶的软管内表面
triples.tail_surface: material that is resistant to acetone and dimethylformamide decomposition
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 耐丙酮和二甲基甲酰胺分解的材料
triples.evidence_text: the internal surface of a hose used to connect an acetylene tank is to be of a material that is resistant to acetone and dimethylformamide decomposition

triples.head_surface: internal liner of the oxygen hose
triples.tail_surface: autoignition temperature of not less than 400°C (752°F) in oxygen
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在氧气中自燃温度不低于400°C
triples.evidence_text: the internal liner of the oxygen hose is to be of a material that has an autoignition temperature of not less than 400°C (752°F) in oxygen

triples.tail_surface: set to discharge at not more than the maximum design pressure of the piping system to a location in the weather remote from sources of vapor ignition or openings to spaces or tanks
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 设定排放压力不超过管路系统设计压力并排向远离点火源的安全位置
triples.evidence_text: These devices are to be set to discharge at not more than the maximum design pressure of the piping system to a location in the weather remote from sources of vapor ignition or openings to spaces or tanks.
Outlet stations are to be fitted with shutoff valves.

triples.head_surface: back flow of gas and the passage of flame into the supply lines
triples.head_canonical_zh: 气体倒流及火焰进入供应管路
triples.evidence_text: Outlet stations are to be provided with suitable protective devices to prevent back flow of gas and the passage of flame into the supply lines.
